# glotfiles

> Free browser-based tool that fuses a PDF, image, video, ZIP or HTML file into a
> single polyglot file: one set of bytes that stays valid in every one of those
> formats at once. No account, no installs, and files are never stored.

## What a polyglot file is

A polyglot file is a single file whose bytes satisfy two or more format
specifications simultaneously. The same file can be opened as a PDF and as a ZIP,
and both readers consider it well-formed. Nothing is hidden, renamed, or wrapped;
the formats genuinely coexist in one byte stream. The technique is long-established
in security research and CTF challenges; glotfiles makes it a two-click operation.

## How it works

Files are combined server-side by splicing format structures so each reader finds
the headers it expects at the offsets it expects. Processing happens in memory and
the result streams straight back; nothing is written to disk or retained.
To open a result as a different format, change the file extension.

## Limits

PDF 50MB · Image 25MB · Video 100MB · ZIP 100MB · HTML 1MB.
Enforced in the browser before upload.
